overview: The subcommittee met to review the Construction Manager at Risk (CMR) procurement process, timeline, and draft Request for Qualifications (RFQ). The committee provided feedback on project descriptions and evaluation criteria before authorizing the chair to finalize the document for the full committee's review.

items.title: CMR Process Overview
items.summary: Matt Gulino provided an overview of the two-phase CMR process, including prequalification of firms and the subsequent request for proposals.

items.title: Prequalification Timeline
items.summary: The committee reviewed the timeline for issuing the RFQ on July 1 and receiving statements of qualification by July 24.

items.title: Coordination with City Procurement
items.summary: The committee discussed the need to coordinate with the Chief Procurement Officer regarding the timeline and whether submissions would be handled through the city or the project manager.

items.title: Subcommittee Meeting Scheduling
items.summary: The members adjusted their meeting calendar for July and August to accommodate the review of qualification matrices and submissions.

items.title: RFP and Interview Planning
items.summary: The committee planned for a mandatory site walk in August and set preliminary dates for construction manager interviews in late September.

items.title: RFQ Submission Requirements
items.summary: The committee determined it would require five hard copies of each firm's submission in addition to electronic versions.

items.title: RFQ Project Description and History
items.summary: Members proposed revisions to the draft RFQ to include project labor agreements, updated student population history, and the removal of references to modular classrooms.

items.title: Sustainability and LEED Goals
items.summary: The committee discussed clarifying that the project's sustainability target is LEED Gold or Platinum rather than the minimum silver requirement.

items.title: Evaluation Criteria and Firm Qualifications
items.summary: The committee debated how to define 'similar projects' to ensure a wide net is cast for qualified firms despite rising construction costs and the unique size of the high school.

items.title: Authorization to Finalize RFQ
items.summary: Approved a motion to authorize Chair Jenny Graham and Ken Lord to finalize the RFQ based on committee feedback for presentation to the full Building Committee.

subject: Construction Manager at Risk Procurement Process
